checks.input_domain: all valid RS error patterns through weight 4
seeded valid DQI error patterns; 64 each at weights 1, 31, 35

structural_invariant: Before point j, the FMA basis determinant is a nonzero scalar multiple of the product of previous point factors. At a distinct next point its evaluated basis is invertible. Applying it to a pristine pair (d,1) cannot produce a zero pivot. The branch rule then selects a nonsingular sample-update matrix. A processed pivot pair is never changed by later steps, so the final pivot sequence allows classical replay of branch decisions.
scope: Local sample-pair updates invert exactly when pivot and branch are available. Exhaustive GF(4)/GF(8) screens found no full-state collisions on their stated domains. This does not provide a reversible branch-replay circuit, its resource count, full liveness, or the score gate.
